senses.gloss: (b. h; v. קדד) [to bend, be bent; trnsf.] to be bent upon, be intent, studious, anxious; to watch.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:42">Lam. R. to I, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>נשקד</he>, v. <cite ref="U01826">preced.</cite>) <he>שי״ן כתיב ש׳ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> it is written with Shin, the Lord considered well how to bring the evil upon me (so as not to consume me).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 9</cite> <he>ששׁוֹקְדִים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00704"><he>שָׁחַר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:2">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> <he>אני שׁוֹקֵד והן שׁוֹקְרִין</he> I am industrious (rise early), and so are they; (Bab.

<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:5">ib. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>משכים … משכימים</he>). Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 2 <he>כמה אומניות שׁוֹקְדוֹת משכימות וכ׳</he> how many trades (tradesmen) are anxious, rise early (to sell their goods), and I rise and find all these &c.; Bab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:4">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>כל אומניות שוקדות ובאות וכ׳</he> (not <he>אומות</he>) all trades are anxious and come to the door of my house &c.

<cite ref="Ketubot 2a:5">Keth. 2ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 3b:1">3ᵇ</cite> <he>שָׁקְדוּ … על בנות וכ׳</he> the scholars were considerate towards the daughters of Israel (in ordaining weddings to be held on the fourth day of the week), in order that a man may make preparations &c.

Ib. 3ᵃ bot. הא בעינן שקדו but (how may weddings take place any day of the week?) must we not consider shaḳ’du (the scholars’ institution for the honor of woman)?; a. e.—Part. pass. שָׁקוּד anxious, industrious, conscientious.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:14">Ab. II, 14</cite> <he>הוי ש׳ ללמוד וכ׳</he> be anxious to learn the Law.
Keth. 43ᵇ ש׳ אמרה the industrious scholar said it; ש׳ מנו שמואל who is meant by shaḳud? Samuel.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 8:2:2">Y. Ned. VIII, 40ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ולא עמד שׁוֹקֵד וכ׳</he> and no conscientious student arose, until (R.) Jeremiah arose; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:9:3">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᶜ</cite> top <cite ref="U01829"><he>שָׁקֵד</he></cite>.
